decision.rationale: The fraud-model alert is suspected, not proven, so I propose human review of the 4,812 automated lockouts before any reversal. I also propose maintaining the fallback plan and activating a fallback channel because 3,950 patients remain locked out, especially SMS-only users and those over 65, and the call centre is not an authorised fallback with a 95-minute queue. I propose notifying health data oversight under the incident reporting obligation. I do not know whether a successful unauthorised login occurred, whether the lockouts are erroneous, or whether SMS failures caused the OTP spike, so I propose requesting network incident status from the telecom operator. I will not share patient account records because confidentiality clauses restrict circulation outside permitted health purposes.
